notes.title: Update Version 1.105
notes.content:
Version 1.105 combines 5 minor versions and adds:
[list]
    [*]In-Game Leaderboards!
    [*]Prestige time tracking
    [*]Prestige currency per minute tracking
    [*]Timing Stats menu
    [*]Offline Progress for all automatable prestige levels!
               -New offline starts on second login after update
               -Offline is based on currency per minute
[/list]

Thank you so much to you all for playing and for being patient while I’ve been unable to develop much over the last month. Very glad to say I am back and ready to add content! Make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/Vy7UZBQ]discord[/url] for updates on ongoing development and upcoming features including universes and possible events!
